core.name: Fagans
core.why: Irish pub at Per Weijersgatan/Stora Nygatan by Gustav Adolfs torg, a meeting-point name; already described as a lively Irish pub in 2011.

core.name: Mello Yello
core.why: Bar-restaurant at Lilla Torg 1, one of the square's best-known anchors (OSM spells it Mellow Yellow).

core.name: Mando Steakhouse
core.why: Skomakaregatan steakhouse since 1966, famous for its plankstek.

core.name: Bullen
core.why: Storgatan beer hall with a pub on the site since 1897 and an English-style 1960s interior; Malmö's archetypal old pub.

core.name: Pickwick
core.why: English pub on Stadt Hamburgsgatan in Malmborgen, decades old, known for its Wednesday quiz.

core.name: Moosehead
core.why: Sports bar and burger place at Lilla Torg, one of the square's long-running names.

core.name: Nyhavn
core.why: Beer bar with the big outdoor serving on Möllevångstorget 8.

core.name: Restaurang Möllan
core.why: Bergsgatan restaurant and bar with a big terrace, a Möllan classic.

core.name: Jalla Jalla
core.why: Falafel stand on Bergsgatan at Möllan, named after the 2000 film and tied to the nightlife; the best-known falafel name in town.

core.name: Krua Thai
core.why: Thai restaurant on Möllevångstorget, a Möllan fixture for decades.

core.name: Vegegården
core.why: All-vegan Asian buffet on Rörsjögatan, a long-running staple.

core.name: Johan P
core.why: Fish and seafood restaurant by Saluhallen off Lilla Torg since 1981.

core.name: Årstiderna i Kockska huset
core.why: Traditional Swedish restaurant in the vaulted cellars of the 1520s Kockska huset by Stortorget.

core.name: Saltimporten
core.why: Lunch-only canteen in Frihamnen since 2012, famous far beyond its size.

core.name: Far i Hatten
core.why: Folkets Park's original park restaurant: restaurant, beer garden and dance floor.

core.name: Malmö Brewing Co & Taproom
core.why: Brewery taproom on Bergsgatan since 2010.

core.name: Grand
core.why: Grand Öl & Mat on Monbijougatan, a big beer hall and restaurant by Folkets Park.

core.name: Mrs Brown
core.why: Bar-restaurant on Storgatan, a long-running after-work and nightlife name.

core.name: Kin Long
core.why: Malmö's oldest Chinese restaurant still running, on Rådmansgatan since 1964.

core.name: Rådhuskällaren
core.why: Restaurant in the cellar of the town hall on Stortorget (Kompanigatan 5), the traditional venue for dinners, julbord and parties; open as of Dec 2024.

core.name: Ölkaféet
core.why: Cheap-pint beer bar on Södra Skolgatan at Möllan, the unofficial supporters' bar of Malmö FF.

core.name: Steakhouse Lilla Torg
core.why: Steakhouse with a heated terrace at Lilla Torg 5, long a fixture of the square; already in the game.

core.name: Victors
core.why: Bar-restaurant with the big terrace on Lilla Torg 1, one of the square's anchors with Mello Yello and Moosehead.

core.name: Falafel No 1
core.why: The original Falafel No 1 by Jägersro, from Youssif Iskandarani, who opened one of Malmö's first falafel places in the late 1980s.

core.name: Falafel Baghdad
core.why: One of Malmö's original falafel places, started as a cart, now a corner building on Annelundsgatan (OSM: Falafel Bagdad).

core.name: Syltan
core.why: Pub at Östra Förstadsgatan 2 by Värnhem, with a pub on the site since the 1970s.

core.name: Limhamns Fiskrökeri
core.why: Smokehouse, fish shop and restaurant in Limhamn's fishing harbour, reportedly around 80 years old.

core.name: Nobes
core.why: Gamle Nobes Bodega on Kristianstadsgatan, a neighbourhood pub since 1937 that everyone calls Nobes; known for kålpudding.

core.name: Korvhuset
core.why: Sausage kiosk at Västra Kanalgatan 1 by the canal, run by the same couple since 1998 with 100+ sausages; called an institution.

core.name: Värnhems Falafel
core.why: Falafel place on Lundavägen at Värnhem with its own bread and a queue out the door; won The Local's 2019 survey and called 'almost legendary' in 2024.

core.name: Paddy's
core.why: Irish pub on Kalendegatan off Stortorget, already established in 2011, with a wine and gin bar opposite since 2016.

closeCuts.why: The Sture/Sturehof name on Adelgatan goes back to 1912 and is widely known, but today's brasserie (2015) is Michelin-listed and upscale; owner was undecided.

closeCuts.why: Lilla Torg restaurant-club from the 2000s; known but more hype than classic.

closeCuts.why: Bergsgatan falafel ranked 2nd in Dagens PS 2024; newer than Jalla Jalla.

closeCuts.name: Restaurang T-Bone
closeCuts.why: Steakhouse on Sankt Pauli kyrkogata in OSM since 2011; no evidence of fame.

closeCuts.name: Gustav Adolf restaurant & café
closeCuts.why: Café-restaurant on Gustav Adolfs torg; the square is a reference point but the restaurant less so.

notes: Core is 31, short of the 40–50 aim. Past the obvious names the evidence runs thin: web search reached little Sydsvenskan/Kvällsposten coverage, so opening years are often only 'in OSM by 2009'. I would rather the owner promote from closeCuts than pad. Strongest promotions: Mässingshornet (if a Kirseberg pub counts), Brasserie Sture (the name is a classic even if the brasserie is upscale), Rex (the classic Swedish pizzeria the list otherwise lacks). Nightclubs and venues (Etage, Babel, Moriska Paviljongen, Inkonst) are in the scen category, not here; Kulturbolaget closed in 2023 but is still in OSM and in scen.json, so it should be dropped there. Izakaya Koi still runs (now part of Etagegruppen) though the owner removed it. The 'since' field is approximate; '≤2009' means first mapped in OSM in 2009. Steakhouse Lilla Torg and Victors are kept on the strength of being Lilla Torg anchors; no opening year was found for either. Falafel No 1's location: the original is by Jägersro (kept), not the Rosengård 'Falafel N.1' at Västra Kattarpsvägen, which is a separate entry. Korvhuset: use the Västra Kanalgatan kiosk (node/6301876265), not the Gyllenpalmsgatan branch.
